mapper.insert: WITH active_signing_key AS ( SELECT kid FROM iam_signing_keys WHERE kid = #{row.kid} AND key_status = 'ACTIVE' FOR SHARE ), active_platform_role AS ( SELECT id FROM iam_platform_role_assignments WHERE identity_id = #{row.identityId} AND role_key = 'PLATFORM_ADMIN' AND assigned_at <= #{row.issuedAt} AND revoked_at IS NULL FOR SHARE ) INSERT INTO iam_access_token_issuances (jti, family_id, identity_id, membership_id, tenant_id, kid, issued_at, expires_at) SELECT #{row.jti}, #{row.familyId}, #{row.identityId}, #{row.membershipId}, #{row.tenantId}, #{row.kid}, #{row.issuedAt}, #{row.expiresAt} FROM active_signing_key WHERE #{row.membershipId}::uuid IS NOT NULL OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM active_platform_role)
mapper.select: SELECT jti, family_id, identity_id, membership_id, tenant_id, kid, issued_at, expires_at, revoked_at, revocation_reason FROM iam_access_token_issuances WHERE jti = #{jti}

SELECT issuance.jti, issuance.kid, issuance.expires_at, issuance.revoked_at IS NOT NULL AS jti_revoked, signing_key.key_status = 'REVOKED' AS kid_revoked FROM iam_access_token_issuances issuance LEFT JOIN iam_signing_keys signing_key ON signing_key.kid = issuance.kid WHERE issuance.expires_at + INTERVAL '30 seconds' > #{at} AND (issuance.revoked_at IS NOT NULL OR signing_key.key_status = 'REVOKED') ORDER BY issuance.expires_at, issuance.jti

SELECT jti, family_id, identity_id, membership_id, tenant_id, kid, issued_at, expires_at, revoked_at, revocation_reason FROM iam_access_token_issuances WHERE family_id = #{familyId} AND expires_at + INTERVAL '30 seconds' > #{at} ORDER BY expires_at, jti

SELECT jti, family_id, identity_id, membership_id, tenant_id, kid, issued_at, expires_at, revoked_at, revocation_reason FROM iam_access_token_issuances WHERE kid = #{kid} AND expires_at + INTERVAL '30 seconds' > #{at} ORDER BY expires_at, jti
